summary: Mobile parity test PASSED for Group 2 — Letters & Follow-ups (triage) + Correspondence detail/editor. All required testIDs render, backend flows return the expected shapes, LLM draft generation completes in ~10s, the 422 missing-fields path highlights the offending inputs and shows lf-error, and the lf-generate CTA is white-on-teal in light mode and white-on-clay in dark mode. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: LettersFollowUps.tsx (mobile): situation labels come from the backend with a literal `{name}` token (e.g. "{name}'s condition has changed and they need more help") and are rendered verbatim. The web app appears to do the same — but worth confirming intent with product / that the token is deliberately left un-interpolated on the triage screen (participant name isn't known yet).

letters/[id].tsx: intake fields are keyed off entry.archetype but fall back to INTAKE_FIELDS.request when archetype is unknown. That's safe on the happy path but will silently render the wrong required-field set if the backend ever ships a new archetype without a mapping — consider a defensive warning.

letters/[id].tsx: after generate, subject fallback is `entry?.intake?.subject`. If a later regenerate returns no subject the draft-subject line is hidden — visually fine, but consider preserving the previously-shown subject to avoid a jarring collapse.
seed_data_creation: Created two throwaway correspondence entries via /api/lf1/correspondence (situation_id=3) as part of the flow. IDs Y8zInPIze58dQIG6, OOFtGrnW7Y5I_J-F, -RqoAPmAsoWEzIIB — harmless, will show up in Cathy's correspondence log.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Letters & Follow-ups mobile parity is fully verified. Triage (/tool/letters-and-follow-ups) renders lf1-open-log, lf1-log-link, lf1-situation-grid with lf1-situation-1..12, and lf1-terms-footer. Tapping lf1-situation-11 opens the lf1-safeguarding-gate modal (lf1-safeguarding-contacts, lf1-safeguarding-close, lf1-safeguarding-letter → reveals lf1-safeguarding-cancel + lf1-safeguarding-proceed). Tapping a normal card (lf1-situation-3, dispute archetype) POSTs /api/lf1/correspondence and navigates to /letters/{id}. Detail editor renders lf-detail-summary, lf-intake-form with lf-intake-participant_name + lf-intake-disputed_charge_summary. Empty-generate triggers 422 → missing fields highlight red + lf-error shows the friendly copy. Filled generate returns lf-draft with lf-draft-subject + lf-draft-body in ~10s; lf-copy button present. lf-generate CTA: light bg rgb(14,77,82) teal + white label + white icon; dark bg rgb(165,81,43) clay + white label + white icon. Group 2 done — next groups (care-plan-reviewer/support-plan-reviewer, invoice-checker, family-coordinator, aged-care-q&a) still on the old FormTool renderer as expected.
